reviews.title: A much needed upgrade
reviews.comment:
The Galleon 100 SD was a much needed upgrade, especially compared to my default Dell keyboard lol
After using it for a full workday, I can say the typing experience feels really clean and satisfying. The keycaps do feel a bit cheaped out on for this price point but I do like the texture on the surface
The built-in Stream Deck is really what ur paying for. Its easy to use, pretty self explanatory, and super helpful if you’re constantly juggling tabs. I’ve been using it to switch songs, open apps, and even switch between light and dark mode
As for the screen display its pretty neat, havent explored it too much but it feels like im iron man when I see the temps so thats dope. The keyboard as a whole barely tracks finger prints aswell
reviews.author: Seahomedog

reviews.title: Arguably The Best Utility-Focused Keyboard on the Market.
reviews.comment:
This is easily one of the most versatile and utility-focused keyboards currently available. The level of accessibility it provides is unmatched, no other keyboard on the market comes close in terms of integration and workflow enhancement. Within an hour of setting up a few basic Stream Deck plugins, I noticed a significant improvement in efficiency and overall fluidity. Simple features like controlling Spotify or monitoring my mouse’s battery percentage became seamless and intuitive.
It’s difficult to overstate how much this keyboard enhances everyday use. The build quality feels premium, the typing experience is satisfying with a pleasant sound profile, and it genuinely makes routine tasks more enjoyable in a way that standard keyboards can't really replicate. For anyone who values quality-of-life improvements in their office or gaming setup, this is a standout option.
That said, the price point is undeniably high, and it may be a consideration for some buyers. Additionally, the absence of features like Hall Effect switches is somewhat disappointing, particularly for a keyboard positioned at the top end of the market. For competitive gamers, especially those who play titles like CS2 or Valorant.
However, for the vast majority of users, this keyboard delivers an exceptional experience and justifies its premium positioning. If you’re looking to elevate both productivity and convenience, this is one of the best investments you can make.
reviews.author: Connor Congdon

reviews.title: Would be an awesome keyboard, if it worked.
reviews.comment:
I REALLY wanted to like this keyboard. It looks amazing and having a built in stream deck would add so much functionality. In fact, I wanted to like it SO much, that I tried to purchase it twice.
The first keyboard I received had an issue with one of the stream deck keys. It would not respond when pressed. Just one of the keys wouldnt work.
To Amazons credit, they shipped me out a new one and it arrived the next day. I tested the stream deck keys, and they all worked. GREAT! I thought I had a functioning keyboard!
That is until I started actually typing. Id write out a sentence and randomly all of my letters were capitalized. I thought maybe being a new keyboard, I was accidently hitting caps lock instead of shift. That is until I very puposly made sure caps lock was of, I pressed and held down shift, caps lock turned on, and I types a lowercase letter.
I googled for issues regaridng the shift key for this keyboard and found many other users complaining of the same issue. One person mentioned they could hold down the shift button and see the caps lock randomly turning on and off repeatedly. I tested and that was happening for me to.
Another user mentioned they noticed sometimes if they press tab, it will enter a tolde "`" I opened notepad and held down the tab button. Sure enough, between some of the tabs, it would place a random ` symbol.
Unfortunately I'll have to give up on this keyboard, return it, and go with something else. Huge bummer. As I said, I really wanted it, but 2 out of 2 boards I received were defective.

reviews.title: Good quality, nice feeling keyboard
reviews.comment: It's a great-feeling keyboard! The keys are light and comfortable without sacrificing the satisfying tactile feedback I love about mechanical keyboard. The side panel is both visually interesting when I'm not using it and full of nice features when I am. Having a knob feels really intuitive and is a nice touch.
reviews.author: Izzy

reviews.title: Software does not Work!
reviews.comment:
Would give this a 5; however, the software that controls the configuration does not work and is very poorly designed. The function keys (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) are not programmed as left and right, which I want to remap from ALT to L-Alt, for example. This only works on the Shift and Alt keys sometimes. When a key is remapped, and you open the application again, it does not show the actual remap key and instead shows the default config, although the key functions for the remap key. Very annoying.
I'll happily update my review if they ever fix this. Great keyboard except for the software.
